description: Labour demand as Indeed sees it, day by day: job postings against 1 February 2020 (= 100), seasonally adjusted, in the US, Canada, the UK, Australia, Germany, France, Ireland, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands and the euro area, with the change over four weeks, a quarter and a year and the distance from the peak; by occupational sector or by state, province or region, ranked; or every economy side by side. Indeed Hiring Lab data (CC BY 4.0). No key.

by.description: total (default): the country's postings; sector: each occupational sector, ranked by its change on a year; region: each state, province or region.

country.description: US (default), CA, GB, AU, DE, FR, IE, IT, ES, NL or EA (the euro area), by code or name; "all" sets every one side by side.

weeks.description: total: weeks shown, a row a week, latest last; default 13.

name: job_postings

outputSchema.description: For a country, rows are weeks (oldest first) with total and new postings against 1 February 2020 (= 100); by sector or region, rows are ranked by the change on a year; for all, a row an economy.

title: Job postings (Indeed Hiring Lab)
